pictures.name: MLK1-Palace-Terrace
pictures.prompt: Ancient India, the upper terrace of a palace in the city of Savatthi at sunset, carved sandstone pillars, silk cushions, rooftops and palms stretching to the horizon. King Pasenadi of Kosala, a broad man in his fifties with a trimmed black beard, in a gold-embroidered white silk garment and a jeweled turban, and Queen Mallika, a graceful woman in her thirties with a long black braid wound with jasmine, in a deep red and gold silk sari, sit together on cushions, relaxed, looking out over the city. Rose-gold evening light, deep blue shadows. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood.
